title: Minnow Mansion | 2804 E Co Hwy 30A | Santa Rosa Beach Rental – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Relax at Minnow Mansion, a charming 3-bedroom Santa Rosa Beach rental with views of Gulf of Mexico, carriage house, and private beach access. Book here!
description_expanded:
Minnow Mansion | Seagrove Beach, FL 30A

2804 E County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Minnow Mansion is the epitome of an Old Seagrove Beach cottage and offers all of the modern-day amenities you expect when staying beachfront. This vacation rental home features rare, unobstructed views of the Gulf of Mexico from the living room, newly designed tower, and sitting space on the dunes. Enjoy true relaxation for you and 8 friends and family members. This home offers 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms (carriage house included in bedroom count).

Surrounded by nature trees and the salty breeze, Minnow Mansion provides all one needs when visiting Seagrove Beach, FL 30A. The main house features beautiful windows with picturesque views of the dunes and emerald toned water from the kitchen, living room, and modern kitchen table. The main house offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The first bedroom has two twin single beds and a full size bed and has a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. The master bedroom offers a king size bed and shared access to the hall bathroom which has a walk-in shower. The carriage house offers a bit more privacy with a queen size bed and bathroom with a walk-in shower. The garage is not for guest usage.

The newly designed tower provides covered seating and unbelievable views of the dunes and Gulf of Mexico. This is the perfect spot to enjoy a good book or indulge in an afternoon nap. If heights are not your thing, there is plenty of covered seating on the porch. Additionally, there is a beach deck with seating and chaise lounge chairs for the whole family to enjoy each other's company. Take a step back from the day-to-day and unwind at this Old Seagrove Beach cottage, Minnow Mansion on 30A.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights:

Sleeps 8

3 Bedrooms

3 Bathrooms

1,564 Square Feet

Beachfront Cottage

Carriage House

Outdoor Shower

Tower Views of the Emerald Coast

Shared, Private Beach Access

Parking for 2 Vehicles

3 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

Main House

- Kitchen with stainless steel appliances and bar stool seating for 4 guests

- Cozy living room with plush seating and gulf views from the couch (only TV in the house is in the living room!)

- Stylish dining table offers seating for 6 guests

- Master bedroom has a king size bed

- Hall bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Guest bedroom with two twin single beds and a full size bed and private bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Over porch with comfortable seating and stairs to the tower with additional seating and stunning views of the beach

- Beach deck with seating and great view of the sunrise and sunset

Carriage House

- Private entrance

- Queen size bed and bathroom with a walk-in shower

Additional

- Parking for 2 Vehicles .

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- Garage is not available for guest usage.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
